entries.reason: Conditionally accepted inherited Moderate risk on 2026-10-23 under the maintainer no-security-degradation criterion: published 1.16.0 already locks API 1.40.0 and enables the same MCP trace-metadata extraction route. Crafted MCP _meta can reach the affected parser; it is not classified as unreachable. Fresh qualified installs use fixed API 1.45.1, but existing compatible installs may retain 1.40.0. The explicit floor proposal remains separate and unshipped because its strict upgrade audit is blocked by Pillow. Original review and expiry dates are retained. See docs/DEPENDENCY_UPGRADE_GATE.md#temporary-opentelemetry-risk-acceptance.
